summary_1line: Vidura warns Dhritarashtra through parables that disunity and greedy ambition will destroy the Kauravas, urging reconciliation with the Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Two birds trapped in a hunter’s net lift the snare together into the sky while the fowler runs beneath them across the earth.
The two ensnared birds quarrel midair and fall tangled to the ground as the waiting fowler rushes forward to seize them.
On a steep mountain cliff glowing with herbs, hunters reach for a jar of golden honey guarded by coiled venomous snakes.
